title: A gift shop in Riyadh
assumptions: A new Saudi company opening a gift shop with staff and a fit-out.

items.name: Company incorporation under the Companies Law
items.quote: A company shall acquire a legal personality upon registration with the Commercial Register.

items.name: Commercial registration
items.agency: Ministry of Commerce, Saudi Business Center
items.quote: Every merchant must register in the Commercial Register.

items.name: Tax, VAT and zakat registration
items.quote: the Person must apply to the Authority to register within thirty (30) days of the end of that month

items.name: Social insurance employer registration
items.quote: An employer shall pay the full amount of contributions due from him and from the contributor within the time limit specified in the Regulations,

items.name: Building permit for the works (Balady)
items.agency: The municipality, through the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing's Balady platform
items.quote: enables beneficiaries to commence construction work in compliance with applicable regulations, after fulfilling the requirements

items.name: Municipal license
items.agency: Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs and Housing (Balady)
items.quote: allows users to commence commercial activities by issuing a Commercial License, along with a Safety Permit issued by the General Directorate of Civil Defense
items.agencyMatch: Ministry\ of\ Municipal\ and\ Rural\ Affairs\ and\ Housing

items.name: Civil Defense safety license
items.quote: along with a Safety Permit issued by the General Directorate of Civil Defense for all commercial activities

mustNotInclude.name: Food steps
mustNotInclude.why: A gift shop sells no food.
